title: A yokai followed you home from the mountain
dek: You took the road at dusk and did not look back. Twelve questions to work out which Japanese folk spirit is keeping pace.

questions.prompt: Footsteps behind you stop when you stop. Start again and they start again.

options.label: Turn around and say good evening
Keep walking, match the rhythm
Take the next turning, casually
Leave something on the path and keep going

questions.prompt: Pick the place you'd stop for the night.

options.label: A shrine gate, lanterns still lit
options.alt: A torii gate with stone lanterns

options.label: A mountain trailhead, sign worn blank
options.alt: A mountain trailhead beneath a wooded peak

options.label: A riverbank with one small boat
options.alt: A quiet river with a small boat

options.label: A stone lantern in tall grass
options.alt: A stone lantern standing in grasses

questions.prompt: A shrine keeper offers you tea and watches you hold the cup.

options.label: Drink it. Trust is a choice
Accept, but don't drink
Refuse politely and leave
Ask what they want first

questions.prompt: A promise made at night still counts in the morning.
I go quiet when I'm upset and let the room freeze.
The vending machine gives you two drinks and takes no money. Nobody is around to tell.

options.label: Take both. Thank the machine
Leave the extra on top for the next person
Check if it's a trick
Come back later with a bag

questions.prompt: Old objects deserve more respect than new people.

options.label: Loud, loyal, slightly too big
Quiet, precise, keeps their distance

questions.prompt: You find a coin on the shrine steps. It's warm.

options.label: Leave it. It wasn't yours
Pocket it and thank nobody
Put it back with a wish
Give it to someone who needs it more

questions.prompt: I apologise more than the situation requires.
Curiosity is a kind of hunger.
Dawn. Whatever followed you is still there, sitting at the end of the road.

options.label: Feed it and let it stay
Name it. Naming helps
Walk into the river and don't look back
Ask it, plainly, what it wants

results.name: Kitsune
results.blurb: You are several versions of yourself at once and all of them are convincing. You read what a room wants and become a slightly better version of it. That's not dishonesty — it's range. Just remember which version is the one that has to wake up tomorrow.
strengths: Adapts to any room in seconds
Finds the exit clever people miss
results.watchOut: The mask is comfortable. Take it off with the people who've earned it.

results.name: Tengu
results.blurb: You have standards and a very low tolerance for people who don't. You'd rather be correct than popular, and you'll say the sharp thing because someone has to. Behind the pride is a genuine wish to see things done well — and a temper that arrives before you've decided to have one.
strengths: Cuts through noise to the real issue
results.watchOut: Precision without warmth sounds like contempt. Soften one sentence a day.

results.name: Kappa
results.tagline: Polite to a fault, apologises to furniture
results.blurb: You're courteous, meticulous and slightly obsessed with doing the right thing. You'll return the borrowed thing clean, with a note. Your politeness is genuine but it can become a hiding place: if you're endlessly accommodating, nobody ever finds out what you actually want.
results.watchOut: Apologising isn't a personality. Take up the space you're already paying for.

results.name: Oni
results.blurb: You feel things at full size and you don't see the point in pretending otherwise. Your anger is honest, your affection is enormous, and both arrive at the same volume. People always know where they stand with you, which is rarer and more valuable than tact.
results.watchOut: The volume can drown the point. Say the same thing at half the size.

results.name: Yuki-onna
results.blurb: You are calm in a way that makes other people check their tone. You don't raise your voice — you lower the temperature. Under the stillness there's a lot of feeling that never gets described out loud, and the people who love you have learned to read the weather.
strengths: Protective in a quiet, absolute way
results.watchOut: The cold is doing damage even when you mean nothing by it. Say what's wrong, warmly.

results.name: Tanuki
results.tagline: Here for a good time and a free meal
results.blurb: You are the social glue: cheerful, shameless, always somehow at the table. You lighten rooms and lower blood pressure. Under the easygoing act you're more observant than you let on — you know exactly who's struggling, and you make sure they get fed.
results.watchOut: The fun version can be used to avoid the real conversation. Have it, once.

results.name: Tsukumogami
results.tagline: The object that's been here longer than you
results.blurb: You are quietly accumulated history. You keep the ticket, the note, the mug from a job you left. Objects aren't clutter to you, they're evidence. You're also more resilient than anyone expects, because you've already survived several versions of your own life.
results.watchOut: Not everything has to be kept. Let one thing go and see if you miss it.

results.name: Rokurokubi
results.blurb: You are physically present and mentally three streets away. Your curiosity stretches further than the room allows, which makes you excellent company and a slightly unreliable dinner guest. You notice things nobody meant you to notice, and you file them away.
strengths: Comfortable being the odd one out
results.watchOut: Curiosity isn't consent. Not everything that's visible is yours to examine.

results.name: The Bakeneko
results.tagline: Was a cat, then wasn't, then was again
results.blurb: You are charming, slightly too knowing, and prone to holding a grudge for eleven years with a pleasant face. You drift between worlds: welcome in the house, at home in the alley, loyal to precisely one person and rude to everyone else.
strengths: Fiercely loyal to one or two people
results.watchOut: The grudge is outlasting its usefulness. Let the tail go.

results.name: The Zashiki-warashi
results.tagline: Small, tidy, brings luck and leaves if insulted
results.blurb: You are the quiet presence that makes a house feel fortunate: things get put away, plants survive, the atmosphere improves. You ask for almost nothing and notice everything. Treat you badly once and the whole place quietly stops working.
strengths: Improves any room you settle in
results.watchOut: You leave instead of complaining. Say the thing before you go.
